2026-08-17.summary:
# Rust Daily Development Digest - 2026-08-17

## Game Planner & Building Optimizations

*   Server performance improved by culling the bone hierarchy on building and boat planners, removing 17 GameObjects per planner.
*   Optimized conditional models to refresh only when changed, preventing unnecessary destruction and recreation.
*   Rooms are now hidden only after being invisible for 5+ seconds to prevent visual glitches during animations and reduce network churn.

## IO System Overhaul & Conversions

*   Continued conversion of IO-related prefabs, including CCTV cameras, windmills, water wheels, Tesla coils, and igniters.
*   Removed old IO code from the battery class.
*   Simplified battery console commands.
*   Set main power slots for EngineListener and AlarmSystem prefabs.
*   Cleaned up TeslaCoil, SolarPanel, and FuelGenerator prefabs.

## UI & Menu Improvements

*   Added a scroll fade/gradient to tabs in the demo UI.
*   Fixed alignment issues on non-keyframable rows in the demo UI.
*   Ordered F1 menu category buttons alphabetically by their translated label.

## Bug Fixes & Refinements

*   Fixed jungle primitive loot box gibs not using the proper material upon destruction.
*   Fixed gibs for the basic crate and its colliders.
*   Re-exported the basic crate to zero out its scale.
*   Fixed an issue where log messages from other threads were not appearing in the console/RCON.
*   Fixed typo and effects firing issues with the honey bandage.
*   Fixed the issue of not being able to transfer water into a held water bucket via the UI.
*   Fixed `MaxPlayers` being incorrect after recent changes to the Nexus system.
*   Fixed Nexus connect modal issues.
*   Fixed performance logging NRE and hot reload issues.
*   Fixed a second client NRE, crosshair NRE, and added custom FP scenario dropdown for multiplayer editor.
*   Fixed `Unsafe.UseMultithreadedScripting` on the client, with ongoing work for IL2CPP builds.

## Content & Testing

*   Added a white boomer firework color variant, including its item, mortar, shell, icon, and PFX.
*   Added a per-face physics material test asset for collider testing.
*   RidableHorse.prefab has been updated.
*   Exported a test list and added test feedback.
*   Consolidated OS-specific calls to `RustNative` for unsafe scripting access, with Linux and Mac builds and tests pending.
*   Moved file storage code to avoid unloading it during domain reloads.
